name: forja-foundryvtt
description: FORJA RPG system for Foundry VTT v13

scripts.build:manual: node scripts/build-manual.mjs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n manual --compendiumType JournalEntry --in packs/_source/manual --out packs
scripts.build:packs: node scripts/build-packs.mjs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n pj --compendiumType Actor --in packs/_source/pj --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n pnj --compendiumType Actor --in packs/_source/pnj --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n animals --compendiumType Actor --in packs/_source/animals --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n criatures --compendiumType Actor --in packs/_source/criatures --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n trets --compendiumType Item --in packs/_source/trets --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n armes --compendiumType Item --in packs/_source/armes --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n armadures --compendiumType Item --in packs/_source/armadures --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n artefactes --compendiumType Item --in packs/_source/artefactes --out packs && npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack --type System --id forja -n efectes --compendiumType Item --in packs/_source/efectes --out packs
